title: Quote: My father was a machinist, and he was a sort of genius with ...
speaker: Steve Jobs
content: My father was a machinist, and he was a sort of genius with his hands. He can fix anything and make it work and take any mechanical thing apart and get it back together. That was my first glimpse of it. I started to gravitate more toward electronics, and he used to get me things I could take apart and put back together.
